name: FPE:S
desc:
* EPILEPSY WARNING: CONTAINS LOUD AUDIO & FLASHING IMAGERY *
FPE:S (Fundamental Paper Education: Survival) is an asymmetrical 3v22 based on the "Basics in Behavior" FPE short created by Katie/A3DGhost.

STUDENTS: Survive the night and fend off Teachers using books & shop items.
TEACHERS: Kill the failures.
ALICE: Unleash your fury by killing Students (even Teachers) and unlock your full potential.

*This game is still in a Beta state, so there may be bugs and is subject to changes.* (Recode update soon!)
